meta.title: APM Tours & Travels - Forex Portal
meta.summary: Customer-facing forex ordering website (buy/sell foreign currency notes against INR) with an RBI/FEMA-aligned KYC checkout, plus a real-time admin console for KYC approval, hand-over, order history, daily GST/service-charge rates and hero banner management.

agent_instructions: Build strictly phase by phase in the order given in build_phases. After each phase run typecheck, lint and that phase's tests, fix failures, then commit before starting the next phase.

Everything under 'compliance' is a hard requirement, not a suggestion. Every numeric limit there must live in src/config/compliance.ts (or the Settings table where marked admin_editable) and never be hard-coded inside components.
All money maths happens on the server in src/lib/pricing.ts. The client only displays quotes returned by POST /api/quote. Never trust client-sent totals.
Do not invent customer reviews, licence numbers, phone numbers or addresses. Use the env placeholders in 'env' and the labelled dev placeholders described in 'reviews'.
Admin authentication is intentionally deferred. Implement the guard seam described in 'security.admin_auth_seam' so it can be switched on later without refactoring.
Where this spec says 'verify_with_compliance_officer', implement the stated default, keep it configurable, and add a line to COMPLIANCE_TODO.md.
Spell it 'Courier' everywhere in UI and code.

business_context.address_from_google_maps: 79, Motilal Colony, Rajbari, Dum Dum, Kolkata, West Bengal 700028
business_context.service: Retail money changing: sells foreign currency notes to outbound travellers against INR, and buys back foreign currency notes for INR. GST and a service fee are charged on each exchange.

assumptions_and_open_questions.assumption: The exchange holds an RBI Full Fledged Money Changer (FFMC) licence. An FFMC sells forex for private and business travel; wider purposes (overseas education, medical, employment, emigration) are normally AD Category-II scope.
assumptions_and_open_questions.implementation: Purposes are config-driven with a per-purpose 'enabled' flag and 'requires_licence' tag. Seed with LICENCE_TYPE=FFMC and all requested purposes enabled; owner must confirm.

assumptions_and_open_questions.assumption: Only foreign currency notes are sold. No forex cards, travellers cheques or wire remittances.
assumptions_and_open_questions.implementation: When an order exceeds the currency-note cap, block it and offer 'Request a Call' instead of offering a card product.

assumptions_and_open_questions.assumption: User did not specify a rate source. Rates are stored per currency (buy_rate, sell_rate in INR) and refreshed from a public reference feed with an admin-set margin.
assumptions_and_open_questions.implementation: RateProvider interface; default provider https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/INR (no key). Margin percent per side lives in Settings. Admin can also override a currency's rate manually from the settings strip.
PaymentProvider interface with a MockProvider (dev) that marks an order PAID. Leave a Razorpay adapter stub. Payment page enforces compliance rule PAY-2 (payer = applicant).
See security.admin_auth_seam. Admin UI shows a persistent red 'Auth disabled - do not deploy publicly' bar while ADMIN_AUTH_ENABLED=false.

list: KYC 'Reject / Request re-upload' action with reason (needed alongside Approve).
'Mark Dispatched' action with courier name + AWB for courier orders, so Track Order can show courier dispatch.
TCS line item and LRS declaration in checkout.
Callback requests panel in admin (Request a Call has to land somewhere).
Audit log and 5-year record retention (no hard deletes).
Privacy, Terms and Grievance pages linked from the footer.

tech_stack.framework: Next.js (latest stable, App Router, TypeScript strict, Server Components by default)
tech_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS (latest), CSS variables for tokens, no component library; use Radix primitives only for Dialog, Select/Combobox, Tabs, Toast
tech_stack.database: Prisma ORM. SQLite for local dev (file:./dev.db); schema must stay Postgres-compatible (no SQLite-only features; status fields are strings validated by zod enums)
tech_stack.validation: zod, shared schemas in src/lib/schemas.ts used by both forms (react-hook-form) and API routes
tech_stack.client_state: zustand store 'orderDraft' persisted to sessionStorage (never localStorage - contains PII)
tech_stack.realtime: Server-Sent Events at GET /api/admin/stream backed by an in-process EventEmitter singleton; client auto-reconnects and falls back to 10s polling
tech_stack.file_storage: StorageProvider interface; LocalDiskProvider writes to ./storage (outside /public, git-ignored). KYC files are only readable through guarded API routes
tech_stack.pdf: pdf-lib on the server for the KYC/order dossier PDF
tech_stack.animation: CSS keyframes for marquees; framer-motion only for modal/step transitions
tech_stack.testing: vitest for lib/ unit tests, Playwright for the e2e flows in acceptance_tests
tech_stack.tooling: eslint, prettier, npm scripts: dev, build, start, lint, typecheck, test, test:e2e, db:migrate, db:seed, assets:fetch

design_system.direction: Minimalist, modern, calm. Generous whitespace, one accent colour, large numerals for money, soft 1px borders instead of heavy shadows, 16-20px radii, subtle motion. Must feel trustworthy (financial) rather than playful.

typography.numerals: tabular-nums on every amount, rate and total

design_system.layout: max-w-7xl container, 12-col grid, mobile-first; all flows fully usable at 360px width
design_system.accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA contrast, focus rings, full keyboard support in modal/combobox/drag list, prefers-reduced-motion pauses marquees and banner autoplay, all form errors announced via aria-live
design_system.currency_format: INR with Indian digit grouping (Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN')); foreign amounts with ISO code prefix

compliance.disclaimer: Derived from RBI Master Direction - Money Changing Activities, RBI FAQ 'Miscellaneous forex facilities' (updated 28 Nov 2025), RBI KYC/AML circulars for Authorised Persons, CGST Rule 32(2)(b) and the Finance Act 2026 TCS rates. The licence holder's compliance officer / CA must sign off before go-live.

rules.rule: Forex is sold only on the traveller's own application and identification. One order = one traveller. No third-party or bulk purchases.
rules.enforce: KYC form collects the traveller's identity; declaration checkbox 'I am the traveller and the forex is for my own use'. Delivery and store pickup are to the applicant in person only.

rules.rule: No foreign exchange is released for travel to Nepal or Bhutan.
rules.enforce: Exclude NP and BT from the destination list; show an info note if searched.

rules.rule: Forex may be bought only close to travel (default: departure within 60 days of order date).
rules.enforce: Travel date field is required for BUY; reject dates in the past or more than max_days_before_travel ahead.

rules.rule: Foreign currency notes/coins are capped at USD 3,000 (or equivalent) per traveller per visit. Exceptions: Iraq and Libya USD 5,000; Iran, Russian Federation and other CIS republics up to the full entitlement; Haj/Umrah pilgrims up to full entitlement or the Haj Committee cash limit.
rules.enforce: Server converts the sum of all BUY lines to USD at the day's reference rate and rejects orders above the cap for the selected destination country. Calculator shows a live 'x of USD 3,000 cash limit used' meter and disables Place Order when exceeded.

rules.rule: Overall Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) entitlement is USD 250,000 per resident individual per financial year (April-March), aggregated across all purposes and all dealers.
rules.enforce: KYC form asks 'Forex/remittances already availed this financial year (INR)'; reject if declared + this order exceeds the limit. Applicant signs the Form A2 cum LRS declaration (DECL-1).

rules.rule: Rupee payment for forex may be accepted in cash only up to INR 50,000. Above that, payment must be by crossed cheque on the applicant's account, banker's cheque / pay order / demand draft, debit/credit/prepaid card or bank transfer. Multiple purchases for the same trip are aggregated.
rules.enforce: If amount payable > 50,000 the 'Cash at store' option is hidden and the UI states why. Aggregation: sum BUY orders for the same PAN or passport in the last 30 days and apply the limit on the aggregate.

rules.rule: Non-cash payment must come from the applicant's own bank account or card.
rules.enforce: Payment page shows the KYC name and a mandatory confirmation; PaymentProvider adapter must record payer name/account for reconciliation; admin dossier shows a 'payer matches applicant' checkbox.

rules.rule: Customer identification with officially valid documents before releasing forex; PAN is required for LRS transactions.
rules.enforce: See kyc.fields and kyc.documents. For Courier fulfilment online KYC is mandatory before payment; for Store Pickup it is optional online but then compulsory at the counter before hand-over.

rules.rule: Originals must be sighted. Online uploads are copies; the delivery executive or counter staff verifies original passport (and visa/ticket) at hand-over.
rules.enforce: Admin 'Handed Over' dialog requires ticking 'Original passport sighted and matches KYC' and 'Handed to applicant in person' before it can be confirmed.

rules.rule: Aadhaar, where offered as address proof, must be stored masked (first 8 digits hidden); Aadhaar is never mandatory.
rules.enforce: Upload hint tells the customer to upload masked Aadhaar; the Aadhaar number is never captured as a text field.

rules.rule: When buying foreign currency from customers, cash payout in INR is limited to USD 1,000 equivalent per transaction for residents and USD 3,000 equivalent for foreign visitors / NRIs; anything above is paid by account-payee cheque, demand draft or bank transfer. An encashment certificate is issued.
rules.enforce: SELL flow asks residency status; shows payout options accordingly; collects bank account details when payout is by transfer; admin dossier PDF includes an encashment certificate page.

rules.rule: For purchases from customers below INR 50,000 equivalent a photocopy of the ID need not be retained; at or above it must be.
rules.enforce: SELL below threshold: ID type and number fields required, document upload optional. At/above threshold: upload required.

rules.rule: Forex brought into India must have been declared on a Customs Currency Declaration Form (CDF) if notes exceed USD 5,000 or total forex exceeds USD 10,000.
rules.enforce: SELL above USD 5,000 equivalent requires a CDF upload.

rules.rule: Returning residents should surrender unspent forex within 180 days of return and may retain up to USD 2,000 in notes.
rules.enforce: Informational note in the SELL flow; return-date field optional.

rules.rule: GST at 18% applies to the value of the money-changing service, not to the currency. Under CGST Rule 32(2)(b) the deemed taxable value is: up to INR 1,00,000 -> 1% of the gross INR amount, minimum INR 250; INR 1,00,001 to 10,00,000 -> INR 1,000 + 0.5% of the amount above 1,00,000; above 10,00,000 -> INR 5,500 + 0.1% of the amount above 10,00,000, maximum INR 60,000. GST also applies to any separate service fee.
rules.enforce: pricing.ts implements the slab table from Settings.gst_slabs; Settings.gst_rate_percent is admin-editable daily. Quote shows 'GST' as one line with an info tooltip explaining it is charged on the service value.

rules.rule: TCS on LRS (FY 2026-27): nil up to an aggregate INR 10,00,000 per PAN per financial year; above that 20% for travel/other purposes, 2% for education or medical treatment, nil for education financed by a loan from a financial institution.
rules.enforce: pricing.ts computes TCS on the portion of (declared prior LRS this FY + this order) that exceeds the threshold. Rates and threshold live in Settings. Quote shows a TCS line only when non-zero.

rules.rule: Applicant signs Form A2 cum LRS declaration: purpose of drawal, source of funds is own, total LRS availed this FY, forex not for prohibited purposes, will surrender unused forex.
rules.enforce: Rendered as a scrollable declaration on the KYC page with a required checkbox + typed full name. Store timestamp, IP and user agent. Reproduced in the dossier PDF.

rules.rule: Records of transactions and identification are preserved for at least five years; suspicious or structured transactions are escalated.
rules.enforce: No hard-delete endpoints for orders, KYC records or documents. AuditLog on every admin action. Orders are auto-flagged (flag badge in admin) when: total > Settings.high_value_threshold_inr; same PAN/passport/mobile has another order within 30 days; order sits within 5% under the USD cap or the INR 50,000 cash limit.

Footer shows RBI licence number and type (env), registered address, grievance officer contact. Calculator and quote carry 'Rates are indicative and are locked only on payment / at the counter'. Consent to data processing (DPDP Act 2023) is a required checkbox on the KYC page with a link to /privacy.

formula_buy: line_inr = round2(forex_amount * currency.sell_rate)  // rate at which the exchange sells to the customer
formula_sell: service_charge and gst computed as for BUY
pricing.snapshot_rule: On order creation persist the full quote, each line's rate and a copy of the Settings values used. Later settings changes never alter existing orders.
pricing.calculator_display: The calculator rows show line_inr per currency (forex x rate). Below the rows, when 2+ currencies exist, show Total (gross_inr). Always show a compact breakdown: Service charge, GST, TCS (if any), Amount payable/receivable.
pricing.usd_equivalent: usd_equiv = gross_inr / USD reference rate; used for CAP-1, SELL-1 and SELL-3 checks.

data_model.note: Prisma models. All ids are cuid. All tables have created_at / updated_at.

Order.ref: string, unique, human-friendly e.g. APM-261115-0042 (date + daily sequence)
Order.payment_mode: ONLINE | CASH_AT_STORE | CARD_OR_UPI_AT_STORE | CHEQUE_DD | BANK_TRANSFER_PAYOUT | CASH_PAYOUT, nullable
Order.relations: lines OrderLine[], kyc KycRecord?, events OrderEvent[]

KycRecord.fields: all fields in kyc.fields as columns

paths.courier: KYC_SUBMITTED (online KYC mandatory) -> KYC_APPROVED -> PAYMENT_PENDING -> PAID (online) -> DISPATCHED -> HANDED_OVER
paths.store_pickup_kyc_at_store: PLACED -> (admin completes/approves KYC at counter) KYC_APPROVED -> payment at store -> HANDED_OVER

transition_guards: KYC approve/reject only from KYC_SUBMITTED, or from PLACED for store pickup when staff records KYC at the counter.
Online payment link is active only when KYC is APPROVED.
DISPATCHED only for COURIER and only when PAID.
HANDED_OVER requires KYC APPROVED, originals_sighted = true and payment recorded (PAID online, or a store payment mode chosen in the hand-over dialog subject to PAY-1).
All transitions go through src/lib/orderMachine.ts, write an OrderEvent and an AuditLog row, and publish a realtime event.

top_of_page.fulfilment_switch: Segmented control 'Courier | Store Pickup' pinned at the top; switching re-evaluates required fields immediately and preserves entered data.
top_of_page.notice_when_courier: Prominent warn-coloured banner: 'KYC is mandatory for Courier delivery. Your order is dispatched only after KYC approval and online payment.'
top_of_page.notice_when_store: Neutral banner with an 'Optional' pill: 'Online KYC is optional for Store Pickup. Complete it now for a faster counter experience, or carry your originals to the store.' plus a secondary button 'Skip and place order'.

kyc.order_summary: Sticky side panel (bottom sheet on mobile) with currency lines, charges breakdown, total, purpose, mobile, fulfilment.

fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.rule: 18+; otherwise show 'a parent/guardian must apply at the store'

fields.name: pan
fields.label: PAN
fields.required: BUY: always for residents. SELL: when INR >= 50,000

fields.name: passport_number
fields.pattern: ^[A-Z][0-9]{7}$ for Indian passports; free text otherwise

fields.name: passport_issue_date, passport_expiry_date, passport_place_of_issue
fields.rule: expiry must be after travel date

fields.name: address_line1, address_line2, city, state, pincode
fields.rule: pincode ^[1-9][0-9]{5}$; for COURIER this is also the delivery address and must equal the address-proof address

fields.name: prior_lrs_inr
fields.label: Forex / foreign remittances already availed this financial year (INR)

fields.name: payout_bank_account_name, payout_account_number, payout_ifsc
fields.required: SELL when payout is by bank transfer

documents.label: Address proof (masked Aadhaar / Voter ID / Driving licence / utility bill under 2 months)
documents.required: when current address differs from passport address, or COURIER

kyc.upload_rules: JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF; max 5 MB each; verify magic bytes server-side; random storage keys; store sha256; drag-drop tiles with thumbnail preview, replace and remove.
declarations: DECL-1 Form A2 cum LRS declaration (BUY)
Typed full name must equal full_name (case-insensitive)
kyc.requiredness: When COURIER: every 'required' rule is enforced and the primary button reads 'Submit KYC & Place Order'. When STORE_PICKUP: the customer may either complete everything (status KYC_SUBMITTED) or use 'Skip and place order' (status PLACED, KycRecord NOT_SUBMITTED); partial KYC is not accepted.
kyc.submit: Single multipart POST /api/orders containing the order draft, KYC fields and files. Server re-validates everything, re-prices, runs all compliance checks, writes Order + lines + KycRecord + documents in one transaction, emits 'order.created', then redirects to /order/{ref}?t={token}.

Country (Currency): searchable combobox listing 'United States (USD)', 'United Arab Emirates (AED)' etc.; search matches country name, currency name and code; flag icon per row
Forex Amount: numeric input with the selected currency code as suffix; live helper text shows the approximate INR
order_widget.on_proceed: Validate, write to orderDraft (side, destination country, purpose, mobile, first line {currency, amount}), then open CurrencyCalculator on the list screen with that currency and amount as the first row.

Logo and one-line description; link columns (Buy Forex, Sell Forex, Currency Converter, Track Order | About, Contact, Store Locator | Privacy Policy, Terms, Grievance Redressal); RBI licence type and number; registered address; 'Rates are indicative' disclaimer; copyright.

floating_actions.behaviour: Fixed on the right edge, vertically stacked pill buttons with icon + label (icon-only under sm). Hidden while the hero is in view; fade/slide in once the user scrolls past the hero (IntersectionObserver) and stay visible for the rest of the page. Hidden while any modal is open.

track_order.ui: Small modal: Order ID + mobile number -> status timeline.
track_order.api: POST /api/track {ref, mobile}; returns only status, fulfilment, timeline (Order placed, KYC submitted/approved/rejected with reason, Payment, Courier dispatched with courier name + AWB, Handed over) and, when KYC is approved and unpaid, a 'Pay now' link. Never returns KYC data. Rate-limited to 5 attempts per IP per 10 minutes; same generic error for unknown ref and mobile mismatch.

other_pages./buy-forex: Page hero with the same order widget locked to Buy, live rate table (currency image, code, name, today's sell rate, 'Buy' button that opens the calculator), documents-required checklist by purpose, RBI limits explainer (CAP-1, PAY-1, ELIG-3), FAQ accordion.
other_pages./sell-forex: Same structure locked to Sell with buy-back rates, payout rules (SELL-1), documents (SELL-2, SELL-3), surrender note (SELL-4).
other_pages./about: Company story, licence details, store photo placeholder, values.
other_pages./order/[ref]: Confirmation + status timeline; access requires the signed token from the redirect or a successful Track Order lookup. Shows order ID with copy button, next step, and 'Pay now' when eligible.
other_pages./order/[ref]/pay: Amount, payer-name confirmation (PAY-2), PaymentProvider checkout. Mock provider in dev.
other_pages./privacy, /terms, /grievance: Static MDX pages with placeholder legal copy clearly marked 'Draft - to be reviewed'.

currency_calculator_modal.component: src/components/calculator/CurrencyCalculator.tsx, mounted once in the root layout, controlled by a zustand ui store so header, widget and rate tables can open it.
currency_calculator_modal.shell: Centered dialog, max-w-2xl, max-h-[85vh], full-screen sheet on mobile; focus-trapped; Esc and backdrop close with an 'unsaved order' confirm when rows exist. Header row: title, optional Back button, Close button.

select.when: Opens here if the list is empty; also shown after 'Add Another Currency'.
select.header: Search input at the top (filters by currency name, code or country), Close button. When reached via 'Add Another Currency' also show a Back button beside Close that returns to the list without adding.
select.body: Scrollable responsive grid (3 cols mobile, 4-5 desktop) of currency buttons. Each button IS the banknote image of that currency (object-cover, 3:2, rounded) with a small caption strip: flag, code, name. Currencies already in the list are dimmed with an 'Added' tick and are not selectable.
select.on_select: Append a row for that currency and switch to the list screen with its amount input focused.

list.rows: One row per currency, in the order added: thumbnail of the banknote image + code | amount input (forex) | read-only display box with the INR equivalent at today's rate, plus a small 'rate' caption | delete (trash) icon button.
list.total: When there are 2 or more rows show a Total row directly beneath the INR column. Always show the charges breakdown from POST /api/quote (debounced 300ms): Service charge, GST, TCS (if any), Amount payable / receivable.
list.compliance_ui: Cash-limit meter per CAP-1 for BUY; inline error and disabled Place Order when exceeded, with a 'Request a Call' link. 'Rates are indicative' caption.
list.footer: Two buttons: 'Add Another Currency' (secondary -> select screen with Back visible) and 'Place Order' (primary -> details tab). Place Order is disabled until every row has an amount > 0 and compliance checks pass. Deleting the last row returns to the select screen.

details.label: Second tab of the popup ('1 Currencies -> 2 Details' stepper at the top)
fields: Purpose dropdown (prefilled from the hero widget when present)
Mobile No (prefilled from the hero widget when present)
Transaction side toggle Buy/Sell if the modal was opened from the header (default Buy)
Fulfilment: two large radio cards - 'Courier - doorstep delivery, online KYC required' and 'Store Pickup - KYC online or at the store'
details.footer: 'Back' (returns to the list) and 'Proceed to Checkout' (saves the draft and routes to /checkout/kyc).

entry_points: Header 'Currency Converter' -> select screen (or list if the draft has rows)
Hero widget Proceed -> list screen with the chosen currency and amount as the first row; purpose and mobile carried into the details tab
Rate table 'Buy'/'Sell' buttons -> list screen with that currency added

admin.layout: Clean, dense, desktop-first dashboard: left-aligned title, top settings strip, tab bar, content. Neutral surface, same tokens as the public site.

settings_strip.position: Top of the dashboard, always visible.
settings_strip.behaviour: Inline editable with an explicit 'Update' button, confirmation toast, 'Last updated {time} today' stamp, and an amber 'Not updated today' pill until the first update of the day. Saves via PUT /api/admin/settings, writes AuditLog, applies to new quotes immediately. A collapsible 'Rates' drawer lists currencies with buy/sell rates, a 'Refresh from feed' button and per-currency manual override.

live_orders.data: All orders whose status is not HANDED_OVER or CANCELLED, sorted by created_at ascending (oldest at the top, newest appended at the bottom).
live_orders.realtime: Subscribes to /api/admin/stream. On 'order.created' append the row at the bottom with a brief highlight animation and scroll hint; on 'order.updated' patch the row in place; on 'order.handed_over' animate the row out.
live_orders.sound: Web Audio API tones generated in code (no audio files): normal order = single soft ping (880 Hz, 150 ms); high-value order (total > threshold) = distinct triple rising chime (660/880/1175 Hz). Because browsers block autoplay, show an 'Enable sound' toggle that must be clicked once per session; persist the preference; show a muted icon when disabled.
live_orders.high_value: Rows with total_inr > Settings.high_value_threshold_inr (default 2,00,000) get a warn_soft background, a left warn border and a 'High value' badge.

actions.label: Mark Dispatched
actions.when: COURIER and PAID and not yet dispatched

actions.label: Handed Over

live_orders.side_panel: Collapsible 'Callback requests' list with a 'Mark handled' button.

content: All customer and KYC fields in labelled groups
Compliance checklist auto-evaluated per rule id (pass / fail / needs review) with flags
Document gallery: each document with inline preview (image or PDF), type label, size, and an individual Download button

'Download all details (PDF)' - server-generated dossier: order, quote breakdown, all KYC fields, declarations with timestamp/IP, document index with sha256, event timeline; for SELL an encashment certificate page
For store-pickup orders without online KYC: the same KYC form in staff-entry mode so counter staff can record KYC and upload scans
actions: 'Approve' (primary): sets KYC APPROVED, order -> KYC_APPROVED then PAYMENT_PENDING, unlocks the customer's online payment, emits realtime update. Confirm dialog first.
'Reject / Request re-upload' (secondary): reason required; customer sees the reason in Track Order and gets a re-upload link.

history_page.content: Table of ALL orders, ongoing and completed, newest first, server-side pagination (50/page).
filters: Date presets: Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, This month, Last month, This financial year (Apr-Mar), Custom range (from/to date pickers)
Date field selector: placed date | handed-over date
Side Buy/Sell, Fulfilment, Purpose, Currency, High value only
Search by order ID, mobile, name, PAN or passport
history_page.extras: Summary tiles for the filtered set (orders, total INR, GST collected, service charge collected); 'Export CSV' of the filtered set; row click opens the KYC page in a new tab. Filters are reflected in the URL query string.

banners_page.content: Vertical list of all hero banners in display order: drag handle, 16:9 thumbnail, alt text, position number, active toggle, delete button.
banners_page.reorder: Drag up/down with @dnd-kit (keyboard accessible); optimistic update then PUT /api/admin/banners/reorder with the ordered ids.
banners_page.add: 'Add banner' opens a file picker: JPG/PNG/WEBP, max 4 MB. Validate the aspect ratio is 16:9 within 1% tolerance and at least 1600x900; otherwise reject with a clear message. Alt text required. New banner is appended last and appears on the landing hero on next load (revalidateTag('banners')).
banners_page.delete: Confirm dialog; prevent deleting the last remaining active banner.

api.conventions: Route handlers under src/app/api. JSON in/out except multipart uploads. zod-validated. Errors as {error: {code, message, fields?}}. Compliance failures use code 'COMPLIANCE' plus rule_id.
public: GET  /api/currencies            -> enabled currencies with rates, countries, image paths
POST /api/quote                 -> {side, lines, purpose, destination_country, prior_lrs_inr?} => full breakdown + compliance results
POST /api/orders                -> multipart; creates order (+KYC); returns {ref, token}
POST /api/orders/[ref]/kyc      -> multipart; late or re-submitted KYC (token required)
POST /api/orders/[ref]/pay      -> starts payment (KYC must be APPROVED)
admin: GET  /api/admin/stream                      -> SSE: order.created | order.updated | order.handed_over | callback.created | settings.updated; heartbeat every 25s

assets.script: npm run assets:fetch (scripts/fetch-assets.ts) downloads and optimises third-party images into /public at setup time so the site never hot-links.

banners.requirement: 4 sample hero banners, exactly 16:9, 1920x1080 WEBP, from free-licence libraries (Unsplash or Pexels licence).
themes: traveller with passport and boarding pass at an airport
airplane wing above clouds at sunrise
world map with currency and travel accessories
banners.treatment: Centre-crop to 16:9 with sharp; add a left-to-right dark gradient overlay in CSS and render headline text as HTML (not baked into the image). Record source URL, author and licence in /public/banners/CREDITS.json.

currency_images.requirement: One banknote image per currency for the calculator grid, 600x400 WEBP in /public/currencies/{CODE}.webp.
currency_images.source: Wikimedia Commons via its API (search 'File: {currency name} banknote', accept only public-domain or CC licences, record attribution in /public/currencies/CREDITS.json).
currency_images.fallback: If no suitably licensed image is found, generate a designed tile at build time: flag from https://flagcdn.com/{iso2}.svg, large currency symbol, code and name on a soft gradient. The UI must look intentional with either.
currency_images.note: Use low-resolution, cropped or angled images only; some central banks restrict full flat reproductions of banknotes.

assets.logo: Placeholder wordmark 'APM Forex' as inline SVG in src/components/Logo.tsx; easy to swap.

reviews.source: Google Places API (New) Place Details with fields rating, userRatingCount, reviews, googleMapsUri. Resolve the Place ID once with Text Search for 'APM TOURS & TRAVELS, Motilal Colony, Dum Dum, Kolkata' and store it in GOOGLE_PLACE_ID.
reviews.limitation: Place Details returns at most 5 reviews per call (most relevant). Two marquee rows need more.
reviews.strategy: scripts/sync-reviews.ts (also exposed as a daily cron route) upserts returned reviews into the Review table keyed by external_id so the pool grows over time; only rating >= 4 with non-empty text are visible by default. Row 1 gets even-indexed reviews, row 2 odd-indexed; if fewer than 6 exist, both rows loop the same real reviews.
reviews.integrity: Never fabricate reviews. With no API key in development, seed 8 cards with source=PLACEHOLDER, author 'Sample reviewer' and text beginning 'Placeholder review -'. In production (NODE_ENV=production) PLACEHOLDER reviews are never rendered; if no real reviews exist the section shows only the rating link to Google.
reviews.attribution: Show author name and photo as returned, a Google mark, and the link to the Google listing, per Places API display policies.

seed_data.country_currency_map: src/data/countries.ts mapping every destination country to its currency (Eurozone countries -> EUR), excluding NP and BT per ELIG-2.
seed_data.store: One store from business_context with env-supplied phone and hours.
seed_data.demo_orders: db:seed --demo creates 6 orders across statuses including one high-value, for admin UI development only.

env.ORDER_TOKEN_SECRET: random 32+ bytes; signs order access tokens

security.admin_auth_seam: src/lib/adminGuard.ts exports requireAdmin(request). middleware.ts applies it to /admin/* and /api/admin/*. While ADMIN_AUTH_ENABLED=false it allows all requests and the admin layout shows a red warning bar. Later, real auth only needs to be implemented inside requireAdmin.
security.kyc_files: Stored outside /public with random keys; served only via guarded admin routes; Cache-Control: no-store; never exposed in public API responses.
security.pii: Mask PAN/passport in list views (show last 4); full values only on the KYC page. Never log KYC fields. sessionStorage draft is cleared after successful submit.
security.input: zod on every route; file type by magic bytes; size limits; filename sanitisation; rate limiting (in-memory token bucket) on /api/orders, /api/track, /api/callbacks, /api/quote.
security.headers: CSP, X-Frame-Options DENY (except the embedded map iframe source allow-list), Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin; robots noindex on /admin, /order and /checkout.
security.order_access: /order/[ref] requires an HMAC token (ref + mobile) issued at creation or by a successful /api/track lookup.

unit: GST = 18% of (taxable value + service charge) and changes when the admin updates the rate.
TCS: travel, prior 9,00,000 + order 2,00,000 -> 20% of 1,00,000; education same inputs -> 2% of 1,00,000; education loan -> 0; total under 10,00,000 -> 0.
CAP-1: USD 3,001 equivalent to France rejected; USD 4,500 to Iraq accepted; USD 3,001 to Russia accepted; mixed USD + EUR aggregated.
PAY-1: total 50,000 allows cash at store; 50,001 does not; two orders by the same PAN within 30 days are aggregated.
SELL-1: resident cash payout offered up to USD 1,000 equivalent only.
ELIG-3: travel date 61 days ahead rejected; past date rejected.
orderMachine rejects illegal transitions (e.g. hand-over before KYC approval).
e2e: Hero widget -> Proceed opens the calculator with the chosen currency and amount as row 1; purpose and mobile are prefilled on the details tab.
Add Another Currency shows the Back button; adding a second currency shows the Total row; deleting returns to a single row without Total.

Courier order: KYC page shows the mandatory banner, cannot submit without required documents; after submit the order appears at the bottom of /admin within 2 seconds in a second browser context without refresh.
Store pickup: 'Optional' notice shown; 'Skip and place order' creates a PLACED order; switching fulfilment at the top toggles the notices and required markers.
Order above 2,00,000 is highlighted in admin and triggers the high-value sound function (assert via a spy on the audio module).
Admin Approve on the KYC page unlocks 'Pay now' in Track Order; after mock payment and dispatch, Handed Over removes the row from the live list and the order shows as completed in history.
Each uploaded document downloads individually; dossier PDF downloads and contains the customer's name and order ID.
Admin updates GST rate and service charge; a new quote reflects them; an existing order's totals are unchanged.
History: 'Today' and custom date range filters return the expected orders; Ongoing and Completed chips work; CSV export matches the filtered rows.
Banners: uploading a 4:3 image is rejected; a 16:9 image is added last; dragging it to the top makes it the first hero slide on the landing page; delete removes it.
Floating Callback and WhatsApp buttons are hidden at the top of the landing page and visible after scrolling past the hero.
About Us opens in a new tab; Contact Us and Store Locator scroll to their sections; logo returns to the top.
Reviews rows animate in opposite directions and stop under prefers-reduced-motion.
Track Order with a wrong mobile returns the generic not-found message.
acceptance_tests.definition_of_done: npm run typecheck, lint, test and test:e2e all pass; Lighthouse on the landing page is 90+ for Performance and Accessibility on mobile; no compliance number is hard-coded outside config/Settings; README documents setup, env vars, the deferred admin auth and how to plug in a real payment provider.
